scenarios.description: EXPERIMENTAL live: claude-sonnet-5-5 discovery → topic-consolidation-v3 consolidation → jev-latest assignment.

expected.outcome: ideal; any deviation is a measurement of the real providers, not a harness failure

topics.name: range and battery life
topics.description: Real-world distance per charge versus the claimed 80 km, effects of hills, cold, rider weight and assist mode, range gauge accuracy, battery degradation and anxiety.

topics.name: motor and assist behaviour
topics.description: How the motor and pedal assist feel and perform: smoothness, jerky pickup, power on hills, noise, cut-out at 25 km/h, torque sensing, assist levels and boost.

topics.name: folding and portability
topics.description: How easy or fiddly folding is, hinge and latch quality, plus carrying the folded bike, its weight and folded size, public transport rules, car boots and storage.

topics.name: ride comfort and rider fit
topics.description: Ride feel over bumps and cobbles, tyres, suspension, saddle, grips, handlebar and seat dimensions, and fit for different rider heights and sizes.

topics.name: charging and battery handling
topics.description: Charge time, charger size and indicators, charging port and plug type, and the removable battery's convenience, key lock and port durability.

topics.name: brakes and stopping
topics.description: Braking performance and issues such as fade, squeal, sponginess, rubbing, lever reach, wet-weather stopping, and brake pad compatibility.

topics.name: price and value
topics.description: Whether the cost is justified, comparisons with other bikes or alternatives, resale value, discounts, sales, and cost of accessories.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
